d: The Trump administration has overhauled US visa rules, imposing fixed-term limits on student, exchange and journalist visas. The move is expected to impact thousands of Indian students, tighten immigration controls and fuel concerns that America is becoming a less attractive destination for global talent. Meanwhile, Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the country's first Hydrogen-powered train in the Northern Indian state of Haryana today. Named, the Namo Green Rail, this train will travel from Jind to Sonipat, covering 90 kilometres in a span of 2 hours with at least 12 stops…
